source_text: Imponet incensum super ignem coram Domino. Ignis examinat. Oratio pura.
thought_title: Incense on the fire before the Lord
orientation: Origen is explaining the high priest's ritual of putting incense on the fire in the tabernacle, applying it to the soul's prayer.
pass_a_gloss: He will place incense upon the fire before the Lord. The fire tests. Pure prayer.

choices.why: Future tense of the ritual action, matching the source's future indicative.
Standard rendering of the prepositional phrase indicating presence before God.
rejected: in the sight of the Lord

choices.why: The verb means to test or prove by fire, fitting the image of fire as a purifying agent.
Noun phrase without verb, matching the source's elliptical style; 'pure' renders pura as the quality of prayer.

bible_refs.note: Imponet incensum super ignem coram Domino

pass_b_english: He will place the incense on the fire before the Lord (Leviticus 16:13). Fire tests. Pure prayer.

last_rejected.why: Missing subject/agent for 'examinat' and logical connection between fire testing and pure prayer.
last_rejected.fix: Fire tests. Let prayer be pure.
last_rejected.ruling: Source 'Ignis examinat. Oratio pura.' is verbless/elliptical; English 'Fire tests. Pure prayer.' matches exactly.
